messages.subject: Re: Normalized data analysis in matR
messages.body_plain:
Nothing you are missing - there is a bug that we are resolving that makes it difficult to perform transformations on "collection" objects.
Currently you need to perform the normalization on the abundance matrix extracted from a collection, for example:

# create a default collection
     my_collection <- collection(my_ids)

# extract the raw counts matrix
     data_matrix <- collection$raw
# normalize
     data_matrix.normed <- normalize(data_matrix)
# and then convert the normalized matrix back into a collection
     normed_collection <- as(data_matrix.normed, "collection")

Note - you will receive an error message that indicates that metadata has been lost.
Then you can use the heatmap and pco functions on the normalized data.

Let me know if this works for you
Cheers
Kevin
